candidate_question: Does LLM-scored firm-specific economic materiality add return information beyond sentiment polarity?
research_question_status: candidate only; this experiment does not select or hard-code the dissertation RQ
purpose: One bounded measurement-first attempt at a new firm-specific financial signal. Stop before return analysis unless the annotation construct is reliable against human coding.

authorisation.source: User approved the explicitly described bounded plan by saying 'Go do this' on 2026-08-12.
authorisation.hosted_processing_scope: At most 2,000 selected Reuters headlines, up to 6,000 cleaned body characters per event, and at most five strictly earlier same-company Reuters headlines.
authorisation.provider_chain: OpenRouter routed only to DeepInfra; Gemma 4 26B A4B IT; FP8; no fallback.

inputs.universe: the immutable original 33 US sector companies
inputs.joined_score_population: the same-33, separately retained backward_2024_2025 and opened_2025_2026 score blocks joined by normalized-headline SHA-256

filters: earliest retained release of an LSEG story family
sample.timing: first XNYS open at least 15 minutes after the source availability timestamp; exchange calendar only, with no price file
sample.spacing: one stable-hash-selected event per symbol and entry session
sample.allocation: 60 or 61 events per company; target 70/30 backward/recent and 40/20/40 FinBERT negative/neutral/positive within company, with deterministic shortage fallback
sample.prior_context: up to five strictly earlier same-company first-release Reuters headlines in the prior 30 days; context may affect novelty only

body_retrieval.reuse: Reuse hash-verified cleaned recent bodies when the selected story ID matches.
body_retrieval.new_requests: Fetch only missing selected story IDs through the logged-in LSEG Workspace session.

human_measurement_gate.stop_rule: Do not load price or return data unless the human labels are complete and the predeclared reliability report passes every primary gate.

return_stage_if_unlocked.primary_signal: signed direction severity multiplied by firm-specific materiality and novelty, with no return-fitted thresholds
return_stage_if_unlocked.primary_incremental_test: date-clustered regression and block-bootstrap out-of-sample loss/IC difference for materiality signal beyond both existing polarity scores
return_stage_if_unlocked.strategy_translation: fixed sparse top/bottom event selection, sector/dollar neutral where feasible, first eligible open, 1- and 5-session horizons
return_stage_if_unlocked.multiplicity: one declared family across incremental regression, IC, and fixed strategy horizons; BH-FDR q=0.05
return_stage_if_unlocked.development_go: open the untouched 2026 confirmation only if the primary incremental coefficient has the predeclared sign, uncertainty excludes zero after multiplicity control, and 10-bps break-even is positive without retuning
return_stage_if_unlocked.claim_boundary: A measurement null is useful dissertation evidence. A development return result is not confirmatory alpha.
